content:
Priya Chen: heads up — we got a customer escalation (ticket #INC-2219) reporting repeated 504s during a traffic burst around 17:05 PDT. They saw ~30s timeouts, then errors stop after ~3 minutes. :rotating_light:
Tom Liu: digging in. Any quick repro or tenant id?
Priya Chen: customer tenant id t-cobalt. They said calls queuing up and then 504 from the gateway. Happened after a scheduled marketing email at 17:02.
Ana (support): I checked logs, gateway shows upstream timeouts to hosted-inference pods, lots of 502/504s. No auth or billing issues.
ops-bot: Autoscaler event detected: scaledobject/t-cobalt-inference failed to create new pods for 3 consecutive scale attempts. KEDA metrics: external/queue-length spiked to 120, pollInterval=30s, cooldownPeriod=300s.
Tom Liu: copy. Can you paste outputs from the cluster?
Priya Chen: pasted below (trimmed):
```
kubectl get hpa -n tenant-tcobalt
NAME                      REFERENCE                         TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
inference-hpa             Deployment/inference-deployment   40%/80%   1         20        1
```
```
kubectl get scaledobject -n tenant-tcobalt
NAME                       SCALETARGETREF                  TRIGGERS
t-cobalt-scaledobject      Deployment/inference-deployment  externalQueue (len>50)
```
```
kubectl describe scaledobject t-cobalt-scaledobject -n tenant-tcobalt
Triggers:
 - type: external
   metadata: queueLength=50
   pollInterval: "30"
   cooldownPeriod: "300"
Failed scale attempts: 3, last error: "scale target busy or unavailable"
```
Mike (SRE): interesting — HPA shows target CPU at 40% of 80% threshold (we're low CPU-wise) but queues high. KEDA should drive pods up, but scaledobject reports busy/unavailable. Could be readiness probes causing pods not to become Ready within KEDA's polling windows. What's pod status?
Priya Chen: pod list (trimmed):
```
NAME                                   READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
inference-deployment-57c9d8b6b-4rj2k   0/1     ContainerCreating   0          2m
inference-deployment-57c9d8b6b-k9t7p   1/1     Running             0          2h
```
Logs from the new pod's init sequence show repeated timeouts initializing model shard: "model-init: loading weights chunk 3 failed after 20s, retrying". Startup time ~40-60s. Readiness probe is HTTP GET /health 10s timeout, initialDelaySeconds=5, periodSeconds=5.
Tom Liu: that explains it. KEDA polls every 30s; if new pods take ~50s to become Ready, and cooldown=300s, KEDA might consider scale attempts failed and not try again quickly. Also HPA target is CPU so it won't scale on queue length. We're mixing HPA and KEDA with mismatched signals.
Ana (support): customer impact: gateway will route to Ready pods only — cold pods stuck in ContainerCreating cause requests to queue and timeout. They expected scale-to-handle burst.
Mike (SRE): immediate mitigations: 1) increase replica min to 3 for this tenant to avoid coldstart for short-term; 2) reduce scaledobject pollInterval to 5s for high-throughput tenants; 3) adjust readiness/startup probe to be less aggressive or use startupProbe to allow longer init without marking as Unready.
Tom Liu: agree. Also add fallback routing: when queue length > threshold route to smaller model variant to reduce init time.
Priya Chen: did a quick patch: bumped minReplicas=3 for inference-hpa for t-cobalt and increased startupProbe failureThreshold to 30 (so init not killed). Applying now.
ops-bot: Change applied by Priya Chen at 17:22 PDT. Autoscaler will not scale-to-zero for this deployment while minReplicas>1.
Tom Liu: next steps (owners):
- Mike: evaluate adding prewarmed instance pool for big tenants (owner SRE)
- Tom: change KEDA pollInterval to 10s and reduce cooldown to 120s for externalQueue triggers (owner: infra team)
- Ana: update incident ticket with repro steps and mitigation, tell customer we applied temp minReplica bump and are monitoring
- Priya: collect model-init logs across tenants to see which images/models have >30s cold starts
Ana (support): documented in ticket INC-2219 and sent ETA to customer: engineering follow-up in 48h.
Mike (SRE): longer-term we should: use startupProbe for model init, ensure KEDA/HPA signal alignment (or use KEDA to drive HPA), and add prewarm option in routing.
Priya Chen: closing slack thread for now — monitoring for 15 minutes, will reopen if errors return. Thanks all :thumbsup:
